title: A statistical measure of trust in generative AI
abstract: arXiv:2611.30286v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Trustworthiness is a crucial issue for generative AI, as modern models can produce convincing and confident responses even when their outputs are incomplete, unsupported, or wrong. The frequent absence of ground-truth knowledge or labels complicates verification of generative AI outputs. To address this issue, we propose a trustworthiness framework grounded in model-internal confidence calibrated against an external expert reference. We estimate per-token trustworthiness of a student generative model as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, where the expert is used as a distributional reference rather than as a source of factual verification labels. To this end, we introduce an AI ontology calibrator that leverages the student model's internal latent features and token-level output statistics to compute expert-reference acceptance scores. translated_title: 生成式AI信任度的统计度量方法
translated_abstract: 可信度是生成式AI领域的一个关键问题，因为现代模型即使输出的内容不完整、缺乏依据或完全错误，也能生成令人信服且语气自信的回答。真实标准知识或标签的频繁缺失使得对生成式AI输出的验证变得复杂。为了解决这一问题，我们提出了一个以模型内部置信度为基础、并通过外部专家参照进行校准的可信度评估框架。我们将学生生成式模型所生成的每个词元的可信度估计为该词元相对于专家模型分布的统计典型性，其中专家模型仅作为分布参照，而非事实验证标签的来源。为此，我们引入了一个AI本体校准器，它利用学生模型的内部潜在特征和词元级输出统计信息来计算专家参照接受度分数。结合传统的词元级置信度……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 本文提出了一种生成式AI可信度评估框架，通过将生成词元相对于专家模型分布的统计典型性作为可信度度量，并引入AI本体校准器，无需真实标签即可实现对生成内容的逐词元信任度评估。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a trustworthiness framework for generative AI that measures per-token trustworthiness as the statistical typicality of each generated token relative to an expert model's distribution, introducing an AI ontology calibrator that enables trust assessment without requiring ground-truth labels.
